analysis.title: GS Sharkey - US Equities Mid Day Color 14 Oct 2026
key_insights: Markets are lower (RTY < NDX < SPX) after a hot CPI print. SPX is down 1.1% at 1:25pm ET with about 65% of the index in the red. It has been 50+ sessions without a 1% S&P sell-off.

The 5y, 10y and 30y Treasury yields all breached their 2007 highs this morning. Rate-sensitive groups underperformed: Non-Profitable Tech (GSXUNPTC) -4.8%, HY Debt Sensitive (GSX1DEBT) -4.5%, Home Builders (GSXUBLDR) -2.5%.
A bid for quality and safety is emerging. Cyclicals vs Defensives (GSPRGDPT) is -1.3% and Healthcare (XLV) is +2.2%.
September core CPI printed at 33bps against consensus of 20bps, driven by a firmer-than-expected shelter reading. Bloomberg puts the probability of an October hike at 40% and December at 88%.
GIR still expects a second Fed hike in December. It looks to tomorrow's PPI report and Warsh's speech in Bangkok for clarity on timing.

Tech is weak under the surface. Neoclouds are under pressure after social media concern over bond yields hitting 15%. SOXX is -3.9% and on track for a sixth straight losing session, its worst streak since July.
Financials earnings were poor: BAC -5.9% on scrutiny of operational flexibility, MS -3.6% on a miss in PT income and wealth, STT -6.3% on a top-line miss from servicing and FX trading.
Technical snapshot: ETF volumes are 33% of the tape (+4% vs 20dma). Exchange volumes are tracking +13% above the 20dma at 9.37bn.
GS flows: activity is 6 out of 10 and overall franchise flows are skewed 8.9% better for sale. Long-only clients are skewed 19.5% better for sale, hedge funds 12.6% better for sale.

Chart of the Day: GS expects the rate of change of growth to decelerate over the next year in both AI and non-AI pockets of the economy. That could support quality, which tends to outperform as earnings growth rolls over. The baskets team favors quality and Defensives over Cyclicals, and likes shorting long-duration pockets such as Low-Quality Equities.
